title: Cold start (WDM supervisor)
description: wdm_supervisor from a cold start at 25 °C: heaters at 0, lasers ramp on over 3 ms; it sweeps each ring to map the lines, assigns lines (a barrel shift is allowed) and locks the rings one by one, in bus order.
frame_reducer_note: each frame is the window (t_s - frame_s, t_s]: means over it unless the unit list says 'last' (value at t_s) or 'min'/'max' (envelope over the window)

drives.note: aggressor_w: power into each aggressor site (window mean); laser_power_factor: chip power of each line relative to nominal (scenario power step x line enable); the cold start's 3 ms laser turn-on ramp is a plant reset protocol, visible in p_in_mw, not in this factor; t_base_k: the die base temperature the thermal model adds every rise to

events.label: lasers start their 3 ms turn-on ramp; heaters at code 0

summary.note: metrics are the engine's own accumulators (every 1 us tick after score_from_s), as `mrm run` reports them
